title: Tenant Security Deposit Withholding
description: Landlord withheld Rs. 50,000 security deposit citing 'repainting' despite no damage.
resolution: Legal notice sent. Landlord refunded 90% of deposit within 14 days without going to court.

title: Unlawful Termination & Notice Pay
description: Employee terminated without 1-month notice or severance pay.
resolution: Filed complaint with Labour Commissioner. Company settled with 2 months pay out of court.

title: Defective Laptop & Warranty Denial
description: E-commerce platform refused to replace a defective laptop worth Rs. 85,000.
resolution: Consumer court notice drafted. E-commerce platform initiated full refund after 5 days.

title: Unpaid Salary for 3 Months
description: IT Company delayed salary for 3 months citing cash flow issues.
resolution: Legal notice sent under Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code (IBC). Full dues cleared in 30 days.

title: Medical Negligence - Wrong Diagnosis
description: Private hospital provided incorrect diagnosis leading to severe complications.
resolution: Consumer dispute filed. Hospital ordered to pay Rs. 5 Lakhs compensation.

title: Flight Cancellation without Refund
description: Airline cancelled flight last minute and refused cash refund, offering only credit.
resolution: DGCA grievance filed and legal notice served. Full cash refund plus compensation issued.

title: Builder Delaying Flat Possession
description: Real estate developer delayed apartment handover by 2 years.
resolution: RERA complaint filed. Builder ordered to pay 10% interest per annum for the delay period.

title: Online Fraud - Bank Refusing Chargeback
description: Credit card fraud of Rs. 40,000. Bank refused to reverse charge despite early reporting.
resolution: Banking Ombudsman complaint filed. Bank forced to reverse the charge fully.

title: Insurance Claim Rejection (Pre-existing condition)
description: Health insurance rejected claim for surgery citing undisclosed pre-existing condition incorrectly.
resolution: IRDAI ombudsman approached. Insurance company ordered to honor the Rs. 2.5 Lakh claim.

title: Eviction Notice without Reason
description: Landlord sent 7-day eviction notice despite active 11-month rent agreement.
resolution: Injunction filed in civil court. Landlord forced to honor the remaining agreement term.

title: Workplace Harassment (POSH)
description: Female employee faced harassment. Internal Committee (IC) dismissed complaint without fair hearing.
resolution: Appeal filed with Local Complaints Committee (LCC). Fresh investigation ordered.

title: Defective Car Delivery
description: New car delivered with manufacturing defect in engine.
resolution: Consumer court ordered dealer and manufacturer to replace the vehicle.

title: Unfair Loan Recovery Harassment
description: Loan app agents harassed family members over unpaid EMIs.
resolution: Cyber cell complaint filed. RBI grievance raised. Harassment stopped and restructuring agreed.

title: Copyright Infringement of Artwork
description: Local brand used artist's illustrations on merchandise without permission.
resolution: Cease and desist notice sent. Brand agreed to pay licensing fee and back-royalties.

title: Breach of Freelance Contract
description: Client refused to pay final milestone (Rs. 60,000) for software development.
resolution: Legal notice for breach of contract sent. Client paid 80% as a swift settlement.
